summary: IonQ, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on October 14, 2026, covering a $2.0 billion registered offering of 20,500,000 common shares and 29,500,000 pre-funded warrants, each bundled with two Series C Warrants for a combined price of $40.00. J.P. Morgan is sole underwriter. Series C Warrants carry a $69.46 exercise price and expire seven years from issuance. The prior day's close was $34.73. This is a routine equity and warrant takedown under an effective shelf registration, not a special situation.
